posts.title: The excellence of Symfony deprecations
posts.description: Based on my Reddit comment: One of the most impressive things about Symfony are the deprecation warnings - it will tell you what needs to be changed or upgraded ahead of time (the only time I’ve seen otherwise was a security fix).
